title: Adaptive Telemetry Fabric for Request-Centric SLO Attribution
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Build an "Adaptive Telemetry Fabric" that unifies tracing hooks, metrics/log pipelines, and downstream SLO evaluation so we can attribute SLO burn and anomalies to request-level dimensions (route, model_variant, tenant cohort) with low overhead and privacy-safe identifiers.

Background: Current SLO signals are computed on aggregated service-level metrics and often miss hot-path regressions tied to model variants, routing fallbacks, or bursty tenants. Pager noise grows when a small subset of routes causes infra-level latency spikes and our burn-rate logic cannot attribute to the responsible dimension quickly.

Scope:
- Instrumentation: add lightweight tracing hooks at SDK, inference-proxy, and gateway layers to capture request context (route_id, model_id, model_variant, plan_tier, hashed_tenant_id, sampling_flags, estimated_token_count, kv_cache_hit, batch_size). Hooks must be opt-in and cost-aware.
- Ingest/transform: enhance metrics/log pipeline to compute request-affiliated metrics (per-route p50/p95/p99, error counts, token-rate) and materialize per-window burn-rate signals.
- SLO evaluation: implement request-centric SLO scorer that can surface top contributors to budget burn, and expose these to alerting rules and the Console.
- Anomaly detection: pair rule-based burn-rate thresholds with a lightweight adaptive detector (EWMA + robust z-score) and a fallback change-point detector for low-volume cohorts.

Non-goals: full per-tenant long-term retention of raw traces, replacing existing global SLOs, or adding heavy ML models for anomaly detection in this ticket.

Why this matters: Enables faster, lower-noise paging by surfacing the causal request dimensions and allows oncall to triage to model/version/route quickly. It also unlocks per-route cost/latency reports in Console and feeds Dedicated capacity scaling signals.
acceptance_criteria: Tracing hooks implemented in gateway and inference-proxy and disabled by default behind a feature flag
Pipeline produces per-route, per-window metrics (p50/p95/p99 latency, error_count, token_count) at 1m and 5m resolution
SLO scorer can compute burn-rate per-route and return top-5 contributors for the last 5m window
Alerting rules: burn-rate + adaptive-anomaly rule created in staging and verified with replayed traffic
Console dashboard tile added showing per-route burn-rate hotspot list and ability to drill into traces
End-to-end latency overhead <1% p95 for production traffic when hooks are enabled with sampled traces
Privacy: tenant identifiers are stored hashed/peppered and cannot be used for direct PII lookups
tasks: Design tracing hook schema and field list (SDK + proxy)
Add feature flag and sampling config to SDK and proxy images
Modify metrics transformer to join trace attributes into time-series keys
Implement SLO scorer microservice with per-window aggregation and top-contributor API
Build adaptive-anomaly detector and alerting rule templates
Add Console panels and drilldown for per-route SLO attribution
Create replay test harness and run canary using staging traffic
Document instrumentation upgrade guide and migration notes for integrators
risks_and_mitigation: High-cardinality tags could blow up TSDB cardinality -> mitigation: hash + bloom filter for rare keys and cap cardinality per-tenant
Instrumentation overhead causing latency regressions -> mitigation: sampled traces, lightweight attributes only, and a staged canary with traffic mirroring
False positives from adaptive detector on seasonal traffic -> mitigation: combine EWMA detector with manual baseline windows and automatic cooldowns
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Design and proto (2 weeks) - finalize schema, feature flags, and pipeline changes
Phase 1: Instrumentation canary (1 week) - enable hooks for 5% of traffic and monitor overhead/metric quality
Phase 2: Pipeline and scorer in staging (2 weeks) - validate aggregated metrics and top-contributor output using replay
Phase 3: Alerting canary (1 week) - enable burn-rate alerting in staging and run ops drills
Phase 4: Gradual production rollout (2-3 weeks) - 10% -> 50% -> 100% feature-flag ramp with rollback gates
Phase 5: Console rollout and docs (1 week)
monitoring_and_slo_tests: End-to-end synthetic tests that inject trace attributes and check SLO scorer attribution accuracy
Run replay of historical incident traffic to validate that top-contributor list surfaces true root cause
Measure ingestion latency for attribute-enriched metrics and ensure <30s end-to-end for 1m window
